description: Use this when the user wants hotels in a destination (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok under $150'), or asks about a hotel by name (hotel_name). Returns up to 10 hotels per page, ranked by the OKstays Comfort Score (0-10 from what guests report: the five must-haves, cleanliness, beds, shower, bugs and safety, count 40%, sleep and room 30%, service 15%, location 10%, extras the place has 5%; repeated complaints about any must-have keep a hotel out) or by a travel style's score (half the Comfort Score, half how well it fits the style), weighing how many guests reviewed each hotel, each with strengths, complaints, indicative price and its okstays.com link. Filters: travel style, signals the hotel must score 8+ on, price, minimum score, neighbourhood, distance from a point, and the kind of stay: property_type hotels (default), apartments, hostels or any (the long-stays persona defaults to any). Pass the user's dates and guests when known. Places to stay only, not flights or car hire. Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

district.description: Neighbourhood to restrict to, e.g. 'Gothic Quarter'. get_city_overview lists the districts; another area name is matched against hotel addresses.

hotel_name.description: Find a hotel by name in this city (part of the name works, e.g. 'Pestana'), including hotels outside our rankings; the other filters are then ignored.

location.description: City name or slug, e.g. 'Barcelona' or 'new-york'. Use list_cities for coverage.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.

near_lat.description: Latitude of a landmark or address the user names (not the user's own location); with near_lng restricts results to hotels within radius_km and reports distance_km.

near_lng.description: Longitude of the point of interest.

page.description: Page of results (default 1; up to 5) for 'show me more'.

persona.description: Travel style to rank for: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort, long-stays.

property_type.description: property_type: hotels (default), apartments, hostels or any. hotels includes guest houses, B&Bs, aparthotels and resorts; apartments includes holiday homes, villas and homestays; any adds every kind, boats and campsites too. The long-stays persona defaults to any.

radius_km.description: Search radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 3).

sort_by.description: best = Comfort Score (default); value = Comfort Score per $100; nearest needs near_lat/near_lng.

tags.description: Filter ids the hotel must score 8+ on, e.g. ['soundproofing', 'reliable_wifi']; their names work too ('quiet'). See get_filters.
